## deploy/release-notes-7.25.4-e1b3.md
1 # Release notes: shipping-api build 7.25.4-e1b3
2 
3 Previous build: 7.24.0. Defaults below override repository config files.
4 
5 - clients: default `clients.pricing-core.timeout_ms` lowered from 2500 to 750 (fail fast)
6 - security: TLS session tickets rotated hourly
7 - retry: idempotent GETs retried once on connect errors
8 - batching: max batch size default 200 (unchanged)
9 - metrics: db pool gauges renamed to `db_pool_*`
10 - logging: structured request ids added to access logs
11 - metrics: new histogram for cache hit latency
12 - deps: http client library upgraded to a patch release
13 - db: default connection pool `db.pool.max_size` lowered from 48 to 12 to fit the shared-db connection quota
14 - health: readiness probe timeout 2s (unchanged)
15 - api: `/v1/status` returns build id
16 - feature flags: `ff-legacy-export` removed (was 0%)
17 - deps: json serializer upgraded
18 - config: `log.level` default remains info
19 - build: container base image refreshed
20 - scheduler: cron jitter added to cleanup job
## ops/oncall-notes.md

5 - 08:28 ingress-a 5xx for shipping-api since build 7.25.4-e1b3 rolled out. Many pricing-core timeouts.
6 - 08:38 Suspect the pricing-core timeout default change in 7.25.4-e1b3; asking for a mitigation.
